title: Add Built‑in Request/Response Logging Middleware
description: Introduce a lightweight, configurable logger that records each incoming request and its corresponding response status, duration, and IP. This improves observability in production without adding external dependencies, helping developers diagnose performance issues and security incidents faster.
testCases: Should log request method, url, and timestamp for a GET request
Should log response status and elapsed time after the response is sent
Should respect user‑provided options to disable logging or change log format
acceptance: A new logger middleware is exported and can be added via app.use(logger(options)). When enabled, it writes a single line JSON log to stdout for every request, includes method, url, status, response time, and client IP. All test cases pass and no existing tests regress.
reason: Observability is a critical production need; adding native logging eliminates reliance on external packages, aligns with the framework's zero‑dependency philosophy, and provides immediate value for debugging and monitoring.
